newsitem.title: UK: BOE allots 5.5 bln stg on UK money market repos.
newsitem.headline: BOE allots 5.5 bln stg on UK money market repos.

text.p: The Bank of England allotted a total 5.5 billion stg in repurchase and secured loan facilities at 5-31/32 percent for the UK money market.
It is offering 5.428 billion stg on the repo due on February 6, 7 and 10 and 72 million on the option maturing January, 23, 24 and 27.
The facilities open on Thursday, Friday and next Monday.
The Bank said applications totalling 27.473 billion stg were received.
